sources.title: Thermal Conductivity ASTM E1530 - Intertek
sources.snippet: The temperature and output of the heat flux transducer is obtained and recorded. Testing is to ASTM E1530 - 06 Standard Test Method for Evaluating the Resistance to Thermal Transmission of Materials by the Guarded Heat Flow Meter Technique. Data: Sample Thickness, Mean Sample Temperature, Thermal Resistance and Thermal Conductivity are reported.
